# doc-metadata-enricher

> Extract title, author, date, language and email, URL and date entities from text, Markdown and HTML with explicit provenance per field and bounded input Python package `trysac-doc-metadata-enricher`, import name `doc_metadata_enricher`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
